subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Sparkling
solution:
The correct answer is Gleaming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Sparkling' is 'Gleaming'.
 
• Sparkling: shining with many small points of light
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Dismal: causing or showing sadness; depressing
 
• Muffled: to wrap up so as to conceal or protect
 
• Gleaming: *giving off or appearing to give off light or brightness; radiant; shining*
 
• Unexciting: not exciting; dull
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.​
